snippet.title: Top Spin 3 (2008) PS3 | Gameplay | Roger Federer vs Rafael Nadal | Maria Sharapova vs Justine Henin
snippet.description:
If you score a point, you get 15.
Then when you score again, you get another 15.
You score for the third time, and by this time you probably already know, you get 10 points.
So now you have 40 points and all you need to do is to score again and you will get 1 point :)
Get 6 of those and you will get yet another 1 :)
Now all you need is to repeat this 3 times and you win :---)))

Played and captured on a PS3.

0:00:00 Intro

0:08:26 Roger Federer vs Rafael Nadal
